Confident irregular dark ink contours around major forms, broad matte flat colour washes, coherent shadow masses and calm secondary surfaces. Entire head and crown within the canvas, generous top and side margins. Distinct realistic human face, legible at 120px. Practical worn linen, wool, leather and plain iron as appropriate to the subject. One single portrait, no text, lettering, heraldry, watermark, frame, scenery, collage or other people. Worn moss-olive wool coat over an unbleached linen shirt, practical simple felt cap held out of frame rather than on his head. A wary slightly disgruntled expression, looking slightly right. An ordinary village farmer with authority, no ornate office costume.
